preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
The integer k is between 1 and 26 inclusive.

postconditions.description: If the length of s is less than k, the output is 'impossible'.

postconditions.expression: len(s) >= k and stdout.strip() == str(max(0, k - len(set(s))))
postconditions.description: If the length of s is at least k, the output is the minimum number of changes required, which is max(0, k minus the number of distinct characters currently in s).
